name: Ivars de Noguera (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with two white arrows in saltire.
history: The official flag of Ivars de Noguera is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with the two white arrows in saltire of the arms, each of thickness 1/36 of the length of the cloth, placed at the centre and at 1/6 from the upper and lower edges; the arrows are the attribute of Saint Sebastian, patron of the town. The arms were approved on 13 October 1997 and the flag on 13 September 1999, published in the DOGC on 18 October 1999.

features.role: two arrows in saltire, the attribute of Saint Sebastian
